name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is an e-commerce-focused helpdesk platform that unifies customer support conversations (email, chat, social, voice) and offers a REST API and AI agent tooling for managing tickets, customers, and automations.
auth_methods: API key (HTTP Basic Auth, private apps)
gating_notes: API access is available on all Helpdesk plans with no paid-tier restriction; account owners/admins can self-generate an API key instantly from Settings > Account > REST API. Regular (non-admin) team members cannot create keys. Public apps must use OAuth2 and go through an app submission/review process for the app store, but private-app API key access is instant and self-serve.
mcp_notes: Official first-party Gorgias MCP server (currently in open beta as of May 2026), hosted at https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp, free on all Helpdesk plans. Ships with ~112 tools: 3 high-level 'smart' tools plus ~109 raw API tools covering nearly every Gorgias REST endpoint (tickets, customers, macros, rules, analytics, help center articles, etc.). Connects via standard MCP client config with browser-based auth against the user's subdomain.
